taste:
The BBQ Bacon Burger combines sweet maple-cured bacon, smoky BBQ sauce and savoury beef and cheddar. The sauce gives it a bold barbecue character, while the melting cheese adds another layer around the tender patty. This is a burger for someone who wants several flavours in the same bite, rather than beef taking the lead on its own.

Texture is just as important here: crispy bacon breaks up the softness of the bun and the tenderness of the beef. Served hot with a hearty portion of golden chips, the plate has more to it than the burger alone. Choose it if that sweet, smoky combination appeals; consider another burger if BBQ sauce is not your preference.
